name: Arizona
agencyName: Arizona Department of Transportation Motor Vehicle Division

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Same-day or next-day retest generally allowed; office policy varies
retake.retakeFee: No separate knowledge-test fee; permit application fee applies

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 30 hours (10 at night); reduced to 20 hours (6 at night) with approved driver education
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving midnight-5 a.m. for first 6 months (exceptions for work, school, or accompanied by parent/guardian)
gdl.passengerLimits: No more than 1 passenger under 18 for first 6 months (exceptions for siblings or when a parent/guardian is present)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Proof of Social Security number (for Travel ID / REAL ID)
Two proofs of Arizona residency (for Travel ID / REAL ID)
Parent or guardian consent if under 18
process.realIdNotes: The Arizona Travel ID is the state's REAL ID. It requires one proof of identity, one proof of Social Security number, and two proofs of Arizona residency, presented in person as originals or certified copies.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.bacLimitUnder21: Any amount of alcohol (zero tolerance for under 21)
facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 8 or more points in 12 months requires Traffic Survival School or may trigger suspension; 13-17 points in 12 months = 3-month suspension, 18-23 = 6 months, and 24+ in 36 months = 12 months
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane or slow down for stopped emergency, tow, utility, and other vehicles displaying flashing lights (A.R.S. 28-775)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 15 mph when children are present and school is in session
